title: Negative-energy-defect = bounded-support TRUNCATION = supply LOWER bound B>=Omega(n^{(k+1)/2}): defect sign pins the two-sided bracket via compact support
evidence: Probe scripts/probes/_407_conn/C090_moment_propagation.py runs EXACTLY the attack_plan: does the proven r=2 fact (in-tree AdditiveEnergyNegClosedLower: E_2(mu_n)=3n^2-3n, re-confirmed exactly 168/720/2976/12096 for n=8/16/32/64 => normalized mu_2=1, mu_4=3-3/n PLATYKURTIC) PLUS the support cap |X|<=sqrt(n) ALGEBRAICALLY FORCE the Gaussian/Bessel baseline mu_{2r} <= (2r-1)!! n^r for all r (which would collapse the open core r~ln q to proven r=2)? NO. Closed-form Markov upper for the normalized 2r-th moment under (mu_2=1, support [-sqrt(n),sqrt(n)]) is mass at the endpoints => m_{2r}^max = n^{r-1}, which EXCEEDS the baseline (2r-1)!! for every r below a large crossover (r*=19 at n=16, r*=83 at n=64) -- i.e. for the ENTIRE deep-moment range r~ln m=21..120 that the prize needs, the high moments are FREE above Gaussian. An exact small-r LP that ALSO imposes the proven mu_4<=3-3/n constraint confirms: max feasible m_{2r} EXCEEDS baseline already at r=3 (ratio 2.15x n=16, 3.66x n=64) and r=4 (4.81x, 13.3x); the mu_4 constraint is non-binding for the tiny-mass far atom that drives the worst case. So the r=2 energy fact does NOT propagate to high moments; there is no Hausdorff/completely-monotone interpolation that caps mu_{2r} from mu_2,mu_4 + support. Additionally the premise's support cap is wrong/circular: the TRUE eta_b L-infinity scale is sqrt(n*log m) (= the quantity B to be bounded), NOT sqrt(n); assuming a sqrt(n) cap would already give B<=sqrt(n) for free, disproving the open core -- false. Same wall as the already-REFUTED C075 (one-sided platykurtic Markov-Krein) and docs/kb/deltastar-407-markovkrein-and-selfimprove-walls-2026-06-13.md: any fixed-order even-moment + support route yields sqrt(n)*poly(m), never sqrt(n*log m).
wall: W-Johnson (Markov-Krein / deep-moment wall: proven low even moments mu_2,mu_4 plus a support cap leave the deep moments mu_{2r}, r~ln m, free above the Gaussian baseline; the true B=sqrt(n*log m) lives in the log-m far-tail extreme-value regime invisible to any finite moment list -- the recognized BGK square-root-cancellation core).
honest_note: The connection's two FACTS are both genuinely true and in-tree: (i) the unconditional char-0 energy lower bound E(mu_n)>=3n^2-3n with energyExcess>=0 (AdditiveEnergyNegClosedLower / EnergyExcessCore), and (ii) the high-order char-p cumulant defect is negative (platykurtic, kurtosis<3). The ERROR is the conjectured LINK: that these two are 'faces of one compact-support constraint' that propagates the r=2 bound to all r. The probe shows the two scales are genuinely independent -- knowing mu_2,mu_4 and a support cap does not determine (even bound) mu_{2r} for r in the deep regime; the extremal measure pushes mass to the support edge and blows the high moments up to n^{r-1} >> (2r-1)!!. Numerics: the closed-form Markov upper and exact moment inputs are rational/exact; the small-r LP is a fine-grid (200pt) interval moment program whose 2-atom extremal vertex is computed in closed form, cross-confirming. This route should be appended to DISPROOF_LOG as the 'moment-propagation / r=2-forces-all-r' variant of the moment-problem no-go (sibling of C075).
